Chapter 979 Chapter 32: The Tenth Evolution Tower (End Of This Volume, Please Subscribe)

Chapter 979  Chapter 32: The Tenth Evolution Tower (End of this volume, please subscribe)

"Galaxy Master, what exactly is your strength?"

Supreme Being Xia Qin couldn't help but ask.

Not long ago, after Lin Yuan stepped into Level Twelve, he had told them that he was comparable to the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.

The nine Supreme Beings of the Human Civilization felt greatly astonished upon hearing this; the peak of the Path Splitting Realm was a level they dreamt of attaining.

But now?

The peak of the Path Splitting Realm?

Could the peak of the Path Splitting Realm casually lift a hand to suppress dozens of ultimate beings at Level Twelve?

And these dozens of ultimate beings at Level Twelve were still under the protection of a defensive secret treasure of the Path Splitting Realm peak.

Forget Lin Yuan being at the peak of Path Splitting Realm, the nine Supreme Beings of humanity, from a distance, watched Lin Yuan's casually condensed dozens of avatars, feeling that any one of the avatars possessed strength close to the peak of Path Splitting Realm.

"Within the cosmos, I am at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm," Lin Yuan honestly replied.

Under the overall suppression of the universe, Lin Yuan could only maintain the combat strength of the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.

"The peak of the Path Splitting Realm?" The Void God Ultimate Being blinked, wondering if the peak of the Path Splitting Realm was really that powerful.

"Within the cosmos you are at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm... but what about outside the cosmos?" The Xuanyuan Supreme suddenly asked.

From the first time Lin Yuan answered about his strength until now, he had always added the limitation of "within the cosmos" before reaching the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.

Initially, the Xuanyuan Supreme did not think much of it, since they too lived within the cosmos, but only after witnessing Lin Yuan's terrifying strength did he realize something was amiss.

"Outside the cosmos, I suppose I would be equivalent to the Sovereign Realm," Lin Yuan said.

His realm was indeed the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, but his accumulated foundation was unprecedented, and his overall combat power was not weaker than that of the Sovereign Realm.

"The Sovereign Realm?" Heartbeats of Xuanyuan Supreme and the others clenched fiercely.

They had received some inheritance from the Chaos Void and knew well the terror of a Sovereign Realm powerhouse, an absolutely superior domain over the Path Splitting Realm.

Yet it was highly likely to be true — if Lin Yuan did not possess the strength of the Sovereign Realm, why would his casually condensed avatars be able to burst forth such terrifying combat power?

"The Sovereign Realm? Stepping into Level Twelve and already reaching the Sovereign Realm?" Supreme Being Xia Qin was somewhat helpless.

Although they had always understood that with Lin Yuan's talent and gift, as soon as he could step into Level Twelve, he would certainly quickly surpass them.

But wasn't this pace too fast?

It's only been a few days since he entered Level Twelve?

"Galaxy Master, how do you plan to handle those Level Twelve aliens?" The Ancient Power Supreme Being asked in a low voice.

"Them?... Just suppress them for now," Lin Yuan said nonchalantly.

These Level Twelve alien races, now all in Lin Yuan's hands, even if they can't be dealt with at the moment, it's only a matter of time given Lin Yuan's rate of growth.

"Suppression is fine."

The Xuanyuan Supreme nodded.

If those Level Twelve beings were indeed let go, there would also be certain risks; suppressing them directly is the simplest way.

"What about the other races?"

Xuanyuan Supreme asked.

All Level Twelve beings of the alien races have been suppressed by Lin Yuan; now this universe could be considered as the backyard of the Human Civilization.

Those peak races, having lost their Level Twelve ancestors, would not even need Lin Yuan's action to lack the capacity to contend with the Human Civilization.

Even without the direct intervention of the Human Civilization, those peak races would voluntarily surrender.

As for the powerful and ordinary races beyond the peak races, the same goes for them, and also the powerful ancient gods that were once carefree.

Originally, they could negotiate and compete with each other, leveraging the influence of the twelve peak races for their own interests. Now, there is only the Human Civilization left.

These carefree ancient gods, where would they dare to waver any longer? Naturally, they would choose to submit to the Human Civilization without hesitation.

"Them?..." Lin Yuan pondered.

Powerful and ordinary races are controlled by the peak races; Lin Yuan did not plan to rescue them.

As for the ten peak race forces...

"Integrate all powerful, ordinary, and weak races into the Human Civilization; as for the peak races, assimilate them as much as possible. Directly kill off the beings above Level Nine from the major peak races," Lin Yuan said.

Beings of Level Nine and above have long lifespans; retaining such powerful individuals would still pose a risk.

Moreover, on the Battlefields of Different Races, nearly every Level Nine alien has stained their hands with the blood of numerous Human Civilization's evolving beings; it would be simpler just to kill them all to avoid future troubles.

What about the members of the peak races below Level Nine? They could be spared, but of course, numerous measures must be put in place to restrict their growth at the genetic level.

With the potential to grow into a peak race, their bloodlines are certainly extraordinary. Human Civilization might find uses for them in the future.

"Understood."

Xuanyuan Supreme and the other eight Supreme Beings nodded their heads.

There was not a hint of pleading or sympathy.

The struggle between races is inherently cruel. If the Galaxy Master had come from another peak racial force instead of the Human Civilization, the fate of Human Civilization would likely be much more tragic than these peak racial forces, and perhaps this universe would no longer even have a race called humans.

In a sense, Lin Yuan was rather merciful, at least giving those peak races a chance to carry on with their bloodline inheritance.

...

The ten great peak races gathered all their strength, hoping for a desperate battle against the Human Civilization, ending in such a way.

The remaining major peak races have chosen to pledge allegiance to the Human Civilization.

"Our race has defeated the Human Civilization on the battlefield multiple times, surrender? I do not wish to surrender!"

"If you don't surrender, you die, choose one."

Many members of the peak races faced a difficult choice, but the majority eventually chose to submit.

As for the Human Civilization, they were not overly coercive, especially towards the ordinary people of the peak races. Their lives continued much as they had before.

The only difference is that the rulers have been replaced by human civilization, and daily life is monitored, but at least they have survived.

"Human civilization... will be the absolute dominion for the long ages to come." Sizhong Ancient God, along with Maduo Traveler and other special life Ancient Gods, descended upon a main star within the borders of human civilization.

This main star was specially used to register the numerous special-life entities who sought allegiance with human civilization. The once unrivaled and mighty Ancient Gods now stood in line outside this planet.

Even Ancient Gods of Level Eleven Perfect dared not make trouble and obediently followed the rules set by human civilization.

"Sizhong Ancient God, right? The great Galaxy Master once said, if Sizhong Ancient God were to come, grant him the position of a Grade-A Guest Elder directly."

A human evolver looked at Sizhong Ancient God and immediately began speaking.

"Grade-A Guest Elder?"

A flash of joy surged in Sizhong Ancient God's heart.

The Human Civilization Alliance divided the powerful Ancient Gods who pledged allegiance into four levels.

Grade-A, Grade-B, Grade-C, and Grade-D.

Those Ancient Gods who once stood against human civilization, regardless of their strength, were all placed as Grade-D Guest Elders.

Grade-D Guest Elders, as the lowest-ranking Guest Elders, were required to guard the secret realms of the border planets for millions, tens of millions, or even hundreds of millions of years, accumulating enough merit for a promotion to Grade-C Guest Elder.

And Grade-C Guest Elders? They were basically Ancient Gods from the Human Civilization Alliance.

Grade-B Guest Elders were Ancient Gods who had contributed to human civilization, with contributions restricted to the period when all major peak races stood independently.

As for Grade-A Guest Elders? These Ancient Gods had a certain degree of say within human civilization, faced virtually no restrictions, and could even enjoy many benefits from human civilization.

As a Grade-A Guest Elder of human civilization, Sizhong Ancient God would likely live even more comfortably than before.

"Sizhong, congratulations..."

"Sizhong, you'll have to pull us up in the future."

Many powerful Ancient Gods looked at Sizhong Ancient God with envy.

"Hahaha, definitely, definitely."

A smile graced Sizhong Ancient God's face, and his heart was blooming with happiness.

Originally, he had wondered if the Galaxy Master would even remember him, considering how he had messed up the task of contacting Tuoba Ancient God for the Galaxy Master.

But now it seems the Galaxy Master was indeed a being of loyalty — he still remembered even that small aid and reciprocated with such a great reward.

"Ancestor, I'm also a Grade-B Guest Elder..." Maduo Traveler couldn't help but speak.

Back in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, an invincible being of the Ninth Rank Alien Race from the Tianyu Clan had asked him to lock onto the position of the Galaxy Master according to karma, but Maduo Traveler had refused.

Maduo Traveler even felt that the Galaxy Master might not even be aware of that incident.

"Galaxy Master..."

Sizhong Ancient God looked moved, feeling that the most correct thing he had done in his life was to have made the acquaintance of the Galaxy Master.

...

Central Star Domain.

The stronghold of human civilization.

Lin Yuan stood shoulder to shoulder with Xuanyuan Supreme and eight other Supreme Beings, gazing at the vast cosmic starry skies.

"So many powerful beings are pledging allegiance, if it weren't for the three goddesses, we really would be overwhelmed," said Xuanyuan Supreme.

The ten pinnacle races, each of their magnitude not weaker than human civilization, pledging allegiance together was akin to human civilization suddenly consuming food ten times its own size.

Plus all the other powerful races, weaker races, and special life forms.

Fortunately, the three goddesses had a terrifying computational power, which allowed them to balance everything and carry out all tasks in an orderly manner.

"Right, Galaxy Master, your Evolution Tower has been established," Xuanyuan Supreme spoke.

Ever since Lin Yuan stepped into Level Twelve, the nine Supreme Beings had been preparing for the construction of the tenth Evolution Tower.

"Yes, in the Central Star Field of Human Civilization," said Xia Qin Supreme.

Including Xuanyuan Supreme, the nine Evolution Towers of human civilization were all situated at the edges of the domain, serving as a deterrence against hostile peak race forces.

But now?

Human civilization no longer had any hostile forces.

And all of this was because of Lin Yuan, so naturally, Lin Yuan's Evolution Tower would be established in the center of human civilization, signifying the strongest Evolution Tower of human civilization.

"Have you thought of a name for the Evolution Tower?" Feather Butterfly Supreme spoke with a smile.

"Let's call it the Martial Arts Evolution Tower," Lin Yuan said.

The Evolution Tower was related to the evolutionary path that the Supreme Beings chose, so naturally, Lin Yuan's Evolution Tower was named Martial Arts Evolution Tower.

"Okay."

Xuanyuan Supreme and the other eight Supreme Beings nodded.

"Galaxy Master, let's go to your Evolution Tower together," said Xia Qin Supreme with a smile. "Let's get familiar with it. To build that Evolution Tower, Xuanyuan and the others have indeed put in a lot of effort."

"Hahaha, thank you," said Lin Yuan, as he stood up and headed to the tenth Evolution Tower of human civilization with the nine Supreme Beings.

...
